plugins.name: performance-engineering
plugins.description: The performance-engineering role's identity + SessionStart orientation only (contract v3, issue-160 round-3 promotion). Decides: 부하/지연 목표를 만족하는가. Per-facet enforcement lives in the sibling performance-engineering-* plugins below.

plugins.name: performance-engineering-proposal-gate
plugins.description: Gates phase-1 performance-engineering proposals on the 6 methodology.md (a) facets (numeric SLO, falsifiable hypothesis, named method+reason, workload characterization, premortem, evidence-citation format); does not touch phase-2 records.

plugins.name: performance-engineering-record-gate
plugins.description: Gates phase-2 performance-engineering records on the 7 methodology.md (b) elements (methodology-cite, repro info, workload-actual, percentile evidence, bottleneck-evidence linkage, exit-criteria verdict, hand-off rationale), with graceful-exit recognition; does not touch phase-1 proposals.

plugins.name: performance-engineering-order-check
plugins.description: Enforces performance-engineering's intra-document section-order constraint (workload characterization before percentile evidence, and its phase-1 equivalent) within a single proposal or record; shared machinery applied to both documents, not a facet-presence check itself.

plugins.name: performance-engineering-checklist
plugins.description: The performance-engineering role's phase-1 and phase-2 human-facing authoring checklists, as literal reference material — no gate, no hook.

plugins.name: performance-engineering-session-informer
plugins.description: Non-blocking SessionStart awareness for performance-engineering: issue/branch, existing PR/approval state, whether this role's proposal/record already exists. Informational only, never gates.
